meta.name: ios-application-dev
meta.description: iOS application development skill covering UIKit, SwiftUI, layout, accessibility, navigation, and platform integration. Use when building or reviewing native iPhone interfaces and Apple-platform UI behavior.

copy.tagline: 构建和审查原生 iOS 应用界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发或审查 iPhone 原生应用界面
copy.tagline_en: Build and review native iOS app interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if developing or reviewing native iPhone app UI

howto.what: Claude 会遵循 iOS 开发最佳实践，例如触控目标不小于44点、优先使用苹果平台惯例、按需请求权限，并将无障碍、动态字体和安全区域作为一等需求。
howto.when: 当你要求构建或审查原生 iPhone 界面、讨论 UIKit/SwiftUI 布局、导航、无障碍、暗黑模式或 iOS 系统集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 iOS 登录界面。
say.note: Claude 会给出符合人机界面指南的布局建议。

say.text: 检查这段 SwiftUI 代码中的无障碍支持。
say.note: Claude 会指出动态字体和安全区域等问题。

say.text: 我的导航栏应该用 UITabBarController 吗？
say.note: Claude 会解释最佳实践和替代方案。

howto.what_en: Claude follows iOS development best practices: touch targets >=44pt, prefers Apple platform conventions, requests permissions in context, and treats accessibility, Dynamic Type, and safe-area as first-class requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build or review native iPhone interfaces, discuss UIKit/SwiftUI layouts, navigation, accessibility, dark mode, or iOS system integration.

say_en.text: Design an iOS login screen for me.
say_en.note: Claude will give layout suggestions following HIG.

say_en.text: Review this SwiftUI code for accessibility support.
say_en.note: Claude will flag issues with Dynamic Type and safe area.

say_en.text: Should I use UITabBarController for my navigation?
say_en.note: Claude will explain best practices and alternatives.
